# Portfolio Builder — Bahrul Bangsawan

> Free bilingual (English / Bahasa Indonesia) builder for a locked Apple Developer Academy portfolio in a fixed A4-landscape layout, with real-time preview and PDF + JSON export. Runs in the browser, no sign-up.

## Pages

- [Portfolio Builder (English)](https://portfolio.pilihpendidikan.com): Build, preview, and download an Apple Developer Academy portfolio (cover + up to five 16:9 project pages) as PDF or JSON, in a locked A4-landscape layout.
- [Pembuat Portofolio (Bahasa Indonesia)](https://portfolio.pilihpendidikan.com/id): Indonesian-language version of the portfolio builder with the same locked layout, real-time preview, and PDF + JSON export.

## Key Facts

- Free to use; no account or sign-up required
- Bilingual: English (default, /) and Bahasa Indonesia (/id)
- Locked Apple Developer Academy format: fixed A4-landscape, up to five projects
- Project images are validated to a strict 16:9 ratio
- Exports a print-faithful PDF plus a re-importable JSON document
- Privacy-friendly: portfolio data stays in your browser
- Built by Bahrul Bangsawan
